title: PLC Studio manifest (plc.json)
description: Describes one PLC folder: what the checker needs and cannot read from the exported files.

name.description: Name of the PLC, as in the TIA project.

cpu.description: The CPU the program runs on.

family.description: CPU family. Decides which instructions, data types and address ranges exist.

failsafe.description: True for an F-CPU that runs a safety program.

tiaVersion.description: TIA Portal version the files were exported from. Selects the version profile.

compiler.description: Compiler settings the exported files do not carry.

iecCheck.description: IEC check: when true, implicit conversions that can lose data are errors.

displayLanguage.description: Language of the comments and titles shown inline, for example en-US. Each user can override it.

languages.description: Project languages. A comment or title missing in one of them is reported as info. Without this list, a text counts as missing a language only when another text of the same file has it.

obs.description: OB attributes the exported files do not carry, by OB name. Without them, a SimaticML export of the OB next to its .s7dcl is read.

failsafeBlocks.description: Fail-safe blocks whose files cannot say so (external .db sources of F-DBs).

mainSafetyBlocks.description: Main safety block of each F-runtime group. With them, the rules about the safety program report errors and F-blocks outside it are listed; without them those rules only warn.

cycleTimeMs.description: Cycle of a cyclic interrupt OB.

folder.description: Folder of the unit, relative to the PLC folder.

namespace.description: Namespace of the unit's objects, as in Filling.FB_Filler.

published.description: Objects of this unit that other units may use.
